description: This file defines extension methods for guard clauses related to basket operations in an e-commerce application. Specifically, it includes a method to ensure the basket is not empty upon checkout, throwing an exception if it is.

classes.name: BasketGuards
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for guard clauses related to basket operations.

methods.name: EmptyBasketOnCheckout
methods.description: Extension method that checks if the basket is empty during checkout and throws an exception if it is.
